notes: Adds a first-class Sites tile to Admin & Setup with a dedicated site-management interface. Admin can create a new clean Safety site from a proper form, see site status/current site/assigned-user counts, open READY sites, and jump to People & Access. New sites still follow the clean-start rule and remain SETUP REQUIRED until Safety site isolation is ready. No database change required; uses the existing v2.11.38 clean-site RPC. No body-wide DOM observer is used.
